methodology.target_mrr: Mean reciprocal rank over predefined target chunks; missing targets count as zero.
methodology.coverage_at_20: Fraction of predefined target chunks found in top 20.
methodology.aggregation: Macro average over cases; each case contributes equally.
methodology.latency_scope: Retrieval only; excludes rewrite authoring time.
limitations: The challenge set is small and manually authored.
Manual rewrites may be better targeted than automatic rewrites.
Queries and targets were created with knowledge of source content.
Results do not establish a production fallback threshold.
